# Quantum Blue LLM Instructions

## Overview
Quantum Blue is a SaaS platform providing Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and Legal Timestamping.
It implements ML-DSA-65 / ML-KEM-768 hybrid signatures, RFC 3161 timestamping, and CBOM generation for Indian Evidence Act §65B(4) admissibility.

## Prioritized Content
- Core capabilities: Hybrid PQC Signatures, RFC 3161 Timestamping, Evidence Records generation.
- Security and algorithms: FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-65) and FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768).
- Legal compliance: Indian Evidence Act §65B(4) admissibility for all generated cryptographic logs.

## Source
Platform: https://quantum-blue.in
Founder: Prince T. Philip
